title: Equations in the Form y = mx Core Test
description: Write and interpret equations of proportional lines in the form y = mx.

questions.questionText: A line goes through the origin and the point (2, 6). Which equation has the form y = mx for this line?
questions.explanation: In y = mx, m is the slope or constant of proportionality. Use m = y/x for a point on the line.
